from openpyxl import load_workbook
from collections import OrderedDict

wb = load_workbook('budget.xlsx')
ws = wb['Budget']

# Verify formulas present
print('Total Income formula:', ws['B8'].value)
print('Total Expenses formula:', ws['C23'].value)
print('Balance formula:', ws['B25'].value)
print()

cats = OrderedDict()
expense_total = 0.0
n = 0
for r in range(11, 23):  # rows 11..22
    cat = ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value
    item = ws.cell(row=r, column=2).value
    amt = ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value
    if amt is None:
        continue
    n += 1
    expense_total += amt
    cats.setdefault(cat, 0.0)
    cats[cat] += amt

print(f'Expense line items summed: {n}')
for c, t in cats.items():
    print(f'  {c}: {t:,.2f}')
print(f'\nTotal Expenses (all categories) = {expense_total:,.2f}')

# Cross-check: independent re-derivation
income_items = [ws.cell(row=r, column=2).value for r in range(4, 8)]
print('\nIncome items:', income_items)
print('Total Income =', sum(income_items))
print('Balance = Income - Expenses =', sum(income_items) - expense_total)
EOF
